svg.text: Participant registration, administration, and the notification worker — with every database read and write shown in order.
Public pages. No login: the e-mailed link is the credential, so a guest never has to invent a password.
Promoted to confirmed automatically when a seat frees up
no write yet — nothing is stored before validation
Server validates fields and the duplicate rule
one atomic unit: the booking, its history and the e-mail are all-or-nothing
the queued e-mail carries /r/:token → band C
requireLogin + requireAdmin guard every route. Each action writes AUDIT_LOGS and queues a notification.
Every branch also writes AUDIT_LOGS (actor, action, entity, before/after) and queues NOTIFICATIONS rows — archiving an event queues one cancellation e-mail per affected participant.
C · Notification worker and guest self-service ( /r/:token )
Delivery happens out of band, so an SMTP outage can never fail a registration; failures stay visible and retryable.
the Requeue button in /admin/notifications drains it immediately
same engine as the logged-in cancel — cancelRegistration()
